mechanism: Paroxetine inhibits CYP3A4 and CYP2D6, increasing dronedarone plasma concentrations and QT prolongation risk; additive cardiac effects including bradycardia and AV block are possible.
action: Monitor ECG and heart rate closely; consider alternative SSRI with less CYP3A4 inhibition; if combination necessary, reduce dronedarone dose and monitor QTc interval.
